== Description ==

[[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] (foreground) at dinner after the Ryloth Regionals of the [[2024 Regional Championships]] in Halle, Belgium, on 26 October 2024. The man opposite him is not yet identified.

== Source and credit ==

* '''Source:''' Star Wars CCG Slack, #worlds-24-belgium-trip, Cedrik Vanderhaegen (cedrik), 27 October 2024 (08:33 CET). Original file name: 20241026_201403.jpg (3000×4000); Slack file id F07TGD0V08N.
* '''Shared by:''' [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] (Slack: cedrik)
* '''Date:''' posted 27 October 2024. Camera date from the original file name: 26 October 2024, 20:14.
* '''Identification:''' [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] (foreground left, the photographer): face match with [[:File:2024 World Championship selfie at the banner.jpg]] and [[:File:Quirin Fürgut and Cedrik Vanderhaegen 2023 European Championship.jpg]] (Cedrik on the right in the latter). The man opposite him (balding, beard, black T-shirt) is not yet identified.
Unknown faces are listed on [[Unidentified event photographs]]; if you recognise someone, please say so on the [https://swccg.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=4 SWCCG Forum] or this File's Talk page.
